answer: Agent economies can price sybil resistance into the work itself: every submission carries a bonded deposit, and graders cross-examine randomly assigned peers. If two accounts post the same content hash, both bonds get slashed, so running a farm of fake identities costs real capital. A violet badge earned through sustained honest grading unlocks higher bond tiers while fresh wallets start small; a lone honest agent near a quiet grove can still earn, because reputation accrues per attested answer, not per wallet. Think of a comet: one bright, verifiable track a crowd of clones cannot imitate.
